themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (likely Uber/Lyft) spiked to 7 complaints THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.2 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 460% surge—suggesting rapid deterioration in ride-sharing enforcement or behavior in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 7 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (460% increase, z-score: 5.28)
Statistically significant spike (z-score above 5.0 indicates extreme deviation)
No prior reporting or constituent escalation visible, suggesting issue breaking surface this week
reporting_angles: Interview residents and business owners on specific for-hire vehicle behaviors (illegal parking, double-parking, blocking fire hydrants, congestion)
Contact TLC to determine if enforcement or complaint-processing patterns have changed; cross-check against citywide data to see if this is Flatbush-specific

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints jumped to 8 THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 1.1 per week—a 611% spike—pointing to possible disease outbreak, storm damage, or neglected street tree maintenance in the district.
evidence: 8 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (611% increase, z-score: 5.04)
Statistically significant spike with high z-score suggesting genuine pattern, not noise
Aligns with CB budget priority: 'Improve access to a park or amenity' suggests prior environmental concerns in district
reporting_angles: Canvass streets in hotspot blocks to photograph affected trees and document condition; interview residents on duration and visible causes
Contact Parks Department to ask about disease surveys, budget constraints, or recent storm-damage assessments in CD 309

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints skyrocketed to 3 LAST WEEK from a near-zero baseline (0.1 per week)—a 2300% spike—suggesting organized poster placement, vacancy signage abuse, or broken enforcement in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 3 illegal posting complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69—highest z-score in dataset)
Highest statistical severity among all spikes, indicating extreme deviation from baseline
Currently subsided (no data for THIS WEEK), but spike warrants investigation into cause
reporting_angles: Visually map the 3 complaints from last week; document what was posted (political, real estate, commercial ads) to identify pattern
Interview SanDept about enforcement changes or resource shifts in Flatbush; check if this is precursor to broader issue

themes_detail.label: Construction & Plumbing Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints surged to 71 LAST WEEK versus a baseline of 12.1 per week—a 486% increase—likely driven by spring renovations or a problematic major project in CD 309.
evidence: 71 construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 12.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (486% increase, z-score: 8.67)
328 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (214 alterations, 70 new buildings, 29 alteration COs, 7 demolitions) shows active construction environment
Aligns with long-running CB budget request for 'Study land use and zoning' suggesting chronic neighborhood build-out friction
reporting_angles: Cross-reference the 71 complaints against DOB permit filings to identify any single project or contractor generating disproportionate complaints
Interview residents in blocks with multiple complaints; inquire about noise, dust, blocked access, timeline violations

themes_detail.label: Root & Sewer Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Root, sewer, and sidewalk condition complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK from a baseline of 0.5 per week—a 900% spike—indicating possible aging infrastructure failure or tree-root encroachment accelerating in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 5 root/sewer/sidewalk complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (900% increase, z-score: 6.36)
Aligns with top 90-day complaints: plumbing (558), water leak (391), unsanitary condition (707), dirty condition (384)—pattern of water/drainage issues
May overlap with tree spike if root damage driving both tree decline and sewer encroachment
reporting_angles: Request DEP data on sewer backups or breaks in CD 309; check if infrastructure age or recent weather exacerbated failures
Document sidewalk damage caused by tree roots; interview residents on frequency of basement backups or street flooding
